entity.name: Abhinav Srivastav
entity.description:
I'm a BSc IT student based in Mumbai, India, and an independent contributor to the Rust compiler and toolchain. I've been contributing to rust-lang/rust since December 2025, with 14 merged pull requests as of 28 October 2026 covering reproducible builds, bootstrap, compiler fixes and regression tests. I've also contributed to the cc-rs project.

My contributions are public: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Aparadoxicalguy

I intend to continue working on compiler correctness, reproducibility and related tooling, including investigating bugs, preparing fixes and contributing regression tests upstream.

projects.name: My contributions to the Rust compiler
projects.description: My individual contributions to rust-lang/rust, made from my fork and submitted upstream as pull requests. This is a personal contribution record, not a project I represent. My pull requests: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Aparadoxicalguy

plans.name: Replacement development laptop
plans.description: One-time grant of INR 100,000 as partial support toward replacing my failing development laptop. The screen is damaged, it overheats and shuts down during compiler builds, and full storage interrupts my work, so I often limit rustc to one or two jobs. A reliable machine lets me keep contributing fixes and regression tests upstream, with progress in public PRs and a short quarterly update. The replacement costs more than this. I will disclose any other funding for the same need to FOSS United.
